<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/reports/labor"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns one row per (pathId, hour bucket) in the half-open window [from, to) compared against `hourBucket`, ordered by hour bucket then path. An empty window is a 200 with an empty `rows` array, not a 404.

Path-scoped counters (`laborAssigned`, `laborReassigned`, `understaffingEvents`) land on the row of their path. Associate-scoped counters (`shiftsStarted`, `shiftsEnded`, `breaks`, `avgBreakSeconds`, `certifications`) land on the row whose `pathId` is the empty string.
